colors.name: Gold
colors.role: Primary action buttons (Request a demo), accent cards - warm yellow against neutral surfaces creates the only chromatic urgency in an otherwise achromatic system

colors.name: Forest
colors.role: Decorative illustration and testimonial card accents - deep dark green used in editorial color blocks

colors.name: Tangerine
colors.role: Decorative scribble accents and highlight strokes in illustrations

colors.name: Royal
colors.role: Soft highlight washes and secondary illustration fills - lighter companion to ultramarine

colors.name: Sky

colors.name: Thistle
colors.role: Pastel illustration fills and testimonial card tints - near-gray mauve

colors.name: Mint

colors.name: Cream

colors.name: Pearl

colors.name: White

fonts.name: Abcwhyte
fonts.role: Single sans-serif family used for everything - display headings, body, nav, buttons, inputs, footer. At 48px/700 with tight 1.25 line-height for hero headlines, dropping to 16px/400 with 1.5 line-height for body. The uniformity of one family at all sizes gives the system a document-like coherence rather than a display/body contrast.

fonts.name: Abcwhyte
fonts.role: UI micro-copy - nav labels, tag chips, small captions, footer links

components.name: Scribble Decoration
components.role: Hand-drawn squiggle and line illustrations in #ffba09 or #ff3b09, placed as decorative accents around sections. Adds warmth and personality without formal imagery.

do: Use 999px or 9999px border-radius on ALL buttons, nav items, and tags - pill shapes are non-negotiable
Use #ffba09 fill with #1a1a1a text for the single highest-emphasis action on any page
Use #f0f0ec as the default page background and #ffffff or #f7f7f3 for elevated card surfaces
Use Abcwhyte (or substitute Inter/DM Sans) as the ONLY font family across all sizes and weights
Use 24px radius for standard cards and 40px radius for hero panels and images - never intermediate values
Separate content layers with color and spacing, not shadows - this system is intentionally flat
Use #1009f6 ultramarine sparingly: feature panels, brand headlines, footer CTA - never as a general accent
doNot: Do not add box-shadow to any card, button, or panel - elevation comes from color and space, never shadow
Do not use a serif or display font for headlines - the single-family approach is the signature
Do not use #1009f6 for body text or borders - reserve ultramarine for card backgrounds and brand emphasis only
Do not use sharp corners (0-8px radius) on content cards - minimum card radius is 24px
Do not introduce a second primary action color - gold (#ffba09) is the only filled chromatic button
Do not use pure black (#000000) for body text - use #1a1a1a for warmer reading
Do not crowd sections - maintain 120px vertical gaps between major sections
